column1: # guard-inputs.tsv -- guard test file -> the repo paths it reads (CI-GUARD-TRIGGERS-1).
# Every Go job in ci.yml skips a docs_only / web_only / go_unaffected /
# operator_only change. The docs-guards job runs, for each changed path, the Test
# funcs of every file below with an input glob matching it
#   file    the _test.go file (all its top-level Test funcs run)
#   globs   comma-separated. glob = an input; !glob = reviewed: the read
#           estimate points at these paths but the file does not read them.
#           '**' is any number of path segments, '*' and '?' stay in one.
#   note    what the file reads, or why a !glob is not read.
# scripts/ci/guardinputs TestGuardInputsCoverSkippedPaths fails a PR that adds a
# guard reading a path whose change alone runs none of its tests, and names the
# globs to add. Over-selecting costs only run time; under-selecting reds main.
